Soojin,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Jane — please find the requested artifacts attached and a short cover summary below. Let me know if you want a live walkthrough with our engineering team.

What we provided:
- subprocessor_inventory_20270409.csv: current list, country of processing column, and a note column for any subcontractor processing US traffic outside the US (LogStream Inc. is noted; we can provide onshore fallback plans on request).
- telemetry_dataflow_diagram_20270408.png: annotated flow showing where identifiers are removed/pseudonymized.
- deletion_log_snippet.txt: redacted example that shows a deletion request ID -> cache purge event -> cache service confirmation. This demonstrates end-to-end purge of KV/prefix caches for a customer-scoped deletion.
- dpa_addendum_draft_20270412.docx: draft language that clarifies our service provider role and enumerates the limited operator exceptions (debug snapshots, on-call troubleshooting) and the contractual controls for those situations.

High-level answers to your questions: none of the core subcontractors for data storage for MedBridges traffic are routinely processing outside the US; only the telemetry routing vendor noted above has a multiregion footprint and is called out in the inventory. We are prepared to add an onshore fallback commitment in the addendum if that is helpful.

Next steps: if you accept the draft addendum language, Marissa can coordinate redlines and we can run a brief technical walkthrough of the deletion flow with Aditya. If you need signed attestation for the inventory, we can provide a countersigned PDF.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
